source.name: Lichess standard rated games
source.ratings: WhiteElo and BlackElo are the source's pre-game ratings

eligibility.ratingBandUses: arithmetic mean of WhiteElo and BlackElo

timeControls.note: January 2013 expert games have sparse rapid and no eligible classical coverage.

sampling.ordering: ascending SHA-256(experimentVersion + NUL + gameId), then gameId
sampling.selection: first target count within each rating band
sampling.colorTarget: both sides of every selected game, exactly balanced

split.method: within each band, selected games in deterministic hash order
split.holdoutRule: evaluated once after validation lock is written

engine.name: Stockfish
engine.confirmation: depth 16/MultiPV 3 only for existing Great boundary policy

features.optionalObjectiveChoice: uniformly exclude only-legal moves; no candidate-separation difficulty claim

validationSelection: For each nonconstant family, select evidence threshold and bounds by lowest validation MAE, tie-breaking by lower complexity, higher threshold, then lexical configuration id. Select the richer family by the same ordering. Write an immutable lock before reading holdout labels.
uncertainty: 10000 deterministic game-cluster bootstrap replicates for holdout MAE difference, SHA-256 counter stream seeded by experiment version

subgroups.requiredDirection: richer MAE lower than accuracy-only in at least three of four rating bands and no material regression in any preregistered subgroup with at least 10 player-games

rejection: insufficient completed corpus or holdout coverage
holdout improvement threshold or confidence criterion not met
rating/result leakage, nondeterminism, opacity, or need for another production engine pass
freezeRule: All 20 criteria in the interval request and every threshold above must pass; otherwise do not freeze chessed-performance-v1.
